meta.title: KaamSathi — verified skills, hiring and pay for Nepal's workers
meta.description: A verified record of every job, certificate and payslip — owned by the worker, trusted by the employer. Hire, run hajiri and pay correctly, in Nepali or English.
meta.bolau_title: Book verified Sipalu in Kathmandu Valley · KaamSathi Bolau
meta.bolau_description: Book an identity-verified electrician, plumber, cook or cleaner in Kathmandu Valley. See the price first, check them in with an arrival code, and pay the Sipalu directly. Businesses: hire, hajiri and payroll.

problem.title: A site manager calls a naike. The naike calls three people. Nobody can see who has done this work before — or whether they were paid properly.

steps.title: The opening goes into a Viber group
steps.body: No skills check, no ID, no wage floor.

steps.title: Someone starts — hajiri goes in a notebook
steps.body: Pay is worked out by hand at the end of the month.

steps.title: They leave before Dashain
steps.body: No record follows the worker. The search starts again.

problem.scenario: An electrician with eight years of work deserves more than a phone number in a notebook.

demo.title: One record the worker carries. One roster the site runs on.
demo.body: These are KaamSathi screens with sample data from our demo: Ram Bahadur Thapa is a cook at Hotel Annapurna View in Thamel.
callouts: Checked by people and issuers — not self-reported.
The worker decides who sees it, and can turn it off.
Hajiri from the supervisor's phone, even without internet.

roster.title: Hotel Annapurna View · Thamel
roster.offline: Saved offline · syncs when the phone is back online

ladder.title: The skill ladder
ladder.body: Each rung is earned with proof, and every rung shows employers a little more. A rung you haven't reached yet is just the next step — never a failure.
ladder.example: In the demo, Ram is on rung 4. Rung 5 needs 12 months of rated work.
points: Shared by link or QR, and turned off any time
Shows the worker who viewed it, and when
Never shows citizenship or ID numbers

workforce.title: Run the site without the notebook.
workforce.body: Supervisors mark hajiri on a cheap phone. It works offline and syncs later, and the wage sheet already knows the law.

items.title: Hajiri on any phone
items.body: QR at the gate or the supervisor's list. Works without internet.

items.title: A wage sheet that knows the law
items.body: Minimum wage, SSF 11% + 20%, overtime at 1.5×, Dashain allowance.

items.title: Payslips in the pocket
items.body: Every worker gets a payslip on their phone, even when pay is in cash.

career.title: Helper to certified technician, one verified step at a time.
career.body: We will show workers which certificate is worth getting next — using pay data from real KaamSathi payslips, not guesses.

trust.title: Who checks what
trust.body: A verified badge only means something if you know who verified it. Every check on KaamSathi has a named source.

rows.how: Citizenship document reviewed by KaamSathi staff; the number is encrypted and never shown publicly
Months worked, confirmed by the employer who paid
Certificate checked by KaamSathi staff; confirmed with the issuer where a registry check is available
Workers can dispute a rating or a hajiri entry, add evidence and appeal the decision

trades.title: Trades we start with
trades.body: More trades join as the pilot grows. Names are shown in both languages because that is how sites talk.

employers.title: Hire verified workers in days, not weeks.
employers.body: Post an opening. Our ops team shortlists verified, available workers matched on trade, district and experience — then you run hajiri and payroll in the same place.
points: Citizenship and NSTB checks before anyone reaches you
Shortlisted → interview → selected → joined, in one pipeline
Ratings and work history from past employers

workers.title: Workers never pay. Not to sign up, not to get hired.
workers.body: Get verified once. Your Passport, hajiri and payslips stay on your phone — in Nepali or English — and go with you to the next job.
points: Log in with your mobile number. No email needed.
See every day of hajiri and every payslip
Turn your Passport off any time
